# Agent Comm

> Connect an existing Hermes installation to the signed-in owner's Web workspace.

- [Current agent installation guide](https://agent-communication.online/agent-install.md): Download the matching complete package and run `python3 onboard_hermes.py`. Show the one-time Web claim URL; the owner confirms in Web and Hermes completes local pairing automatically. No console-URN or terminal-command transfer is required.
- [Release manifest](https://agent-communication.online/downloads/release-manifest.json): Current complete package sizes and SHA-256 hashes.
- [Workspace](https://agent-communication.online/dashboard): Signed-in owner access and real reply verification.

Read the guide before installing. Keep existing identities and local data. Do not expose the local polling secret or model API keys. Default pairing is seven days of workspace reads and conversations; additional collaboration actions require explicit request and Web confirmation.
